# Zio Car Rentals - Self Drive Car Rental Service in Goa & India

> Zio Car Rentals provides premium self-drive car rentals in Goa and across India with unlimited kilometers, airport pickup (Dabolim & Mopa), transparent pricing, and 24/7 roadside assistance.

## Core Information
- **Brand Name**: Zio Car Rentals
- **Slogan**: Freedom to Explore
- **Website**: https://www.ziocarrentals.com
- **Phone / Call**: +91 90828 88912
- **WhatsApp / Secondary Contact**: +91 7977288350
- **Email**: info@ziocarrentals.com
- **Address**: Shop no. 1, Mini Max Apartment, ND Naik Rd, Madgaon, Goa 403601
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹999/day for hatchbacks, ₹2,000/day for SUVs, and ₹15,000/day for luxury vehicles.

## Key Services
- **Airport Transfers**: Direct vehicle pickup and drop-off at Dabolim International Airport (GOI) and Manohar International Airport (Mopa - GOX).
- **Pick and Drop**: Door-to-door vehicle delivery to hotels, resorts, or any location across Goa.
- **24/7 Customer Support**: Round-the-clock roadside assistance and instant booking confirmation.
- **Flexible Plans**: 2-day rentals, weekly packages, and long-term monthly rentals with zero hidden charges.

## FAQs & Rental Policies
- **Required Documents**: Valid Driving Licence, Government-issued Photo ID (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID).
- **Security Deposit**: Refundable security deposit depending on car category.
- **Fuel Policy**: Returned with the agreed fuel level as per rental terms.
